name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Replaced the old cramped in-Jellyfin config page with a standalone admin page at Plugins/Federation/App - servers, friends, pools, and libraries in one simple, dedicated UI instead of squeezed into Jellyfin's plugin-settings chrome. It rides Jellyfin's own existing port rather than opening a new one: a plugin can't make Docker/Podman publish a new port on its own (that's decided when the container is created), so anything else would have needed manual container/router config to ever be reachable. This needs none - install the plugin and the page just works, same as everything else it already serves.

Also new: an optional username + avatar for this server (avatar fetched peer-to-peer, directly from this server, never uploaded anywhere), and a small, optional, self-hostable friend directory - point at one you trust (yours or a friend's) to search by username or hand out a short invite code instead of a full server address. Redeeming a code or a search result is still just an ordinary friend request under the hood; the other admin still has to click Accept.

187 tests (up from 164).
